description: Outputs the highest and the lowest of four input voltages

inputs.text: The first of the four voltages being compared; the other three jacks normal from it, so patching this one alone sets all four
One of the voltages being compared; left unpatched it repeats the jack above it

outputs.text: The lowest voltage found across the four inputs
The highest voltage found across the four inputs

notes: patching the inputs from the bottom upwards and leaving the top jack empty holds one input at 0V, which makes the Max output a half-wave rectifier
